name: power-my-analytics
description: Ask ChatGPT about your marketing data from 85+ platforms and get answers from the data Power My Analytics has synced for your connected sources.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT about your marketing data from 85+ platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, GA4, Shopify, TikTok, LinkedIn and more, and get answers based on your real numbers.

Power My Analytics stores your data in a warehouse, so ChatGPT can analyze the history you have synced across your connected platforms, not just a single live API call.

What you can do:
- Compare spend, conversions and ROAS across your connected platforms
- Find what changed: anomalies, trends and period-over-period shifts
- See which campaigns, countries or devices drove a change
- Forecast where your metrics are heading
- Analyze any date range in your synced data
- Build and manage blended datasets
- Run custom queries with your own metrics, dimensions and filters

Requires a Power My Analytics account with at least one connected data source.
defaultPrompt: Which campaigns drove the most conversions last month across Google Ads and Meta?
Why did my cost per lead change last week? Check every platform.
Compare ROAS by platform for Q3 and rank them.

positive.description: List all connected data sources for the organization
positive.prompt: What data sources do I currently have connected in Power My Analytics?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a paginated list of connected platforms grouped by connector, with human-readable platform titles (e.g., Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify), the connected account names/IDs, last sync times, and connection status.

positive.description: Cross-platform spend and ROAS comparison between two ad platforms
positive.prompt: Compare my Google Ads and Facebook Ads spend and ROAS for Q1 2026 (Jan 1 to Mar 31).
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a side-by-side breakdown for each platform showing: platform name, total spend (currency-formatted), conversions/revenue, and computed ROAS. If one platform has no data, it returns a per-source error with suggestion while still returning the successful platform's data.

positive.description: Anomaly detection on Shopify revenue to surface unusual spikes or drops
positive.prompt: Did anything unusual happen with my Shopify revenue last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of anomalies detected for the Shopify connector over the past 7 days, with each anomaly containing: the date, the affected metric, the magnitude of deviation (absolute and % change vs. baseline), and a plain-English description.

positive.description: Year-over-year date range comparison across all connected ad platforms
positive.prompt: How did my ad spend in April 2026 compare to April 2025?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a comparison table per platform showing: current period spend, prior period spend, absolute change (currency-formatted), and percentage change. A roll-up 'All platforms' total is included.

positive.description: Unified multi-platform performance summary for the current month
positive.prompt: Give me a summary of how all my platforms are performing this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a single aggregated overview spanning every connected platform for the current month-to-date, including: total spend, total revenue, total conversions, blended ROAS, and a per-platform mini-breakdown.

negative.description: General web research question about marketing concepts
negative.prompt: What is ROAS and why is it important for measuring Facebook Ads performance?

negative.description: Account/billing administration request requiring browser-based UI flows
negative.prompt: Connect my Shopify store to Power My Analytics and update my credit card on file.

negative.description: Content creation / creative writing task that references advertising
negative.prompt: Write me 5 catchy headlines I can use for a new Google Ads campaign promoting summer running shoes.
